decisions.reason: It still has a dedicated product page in 2024, so for a mature German machinery firm it likely remains close enough to aspiration levels to justify keeping while uncertainty resolves.
Continued full presentation in 2024 suggests acceptable market traction, and with no clear sign of underperformance management would keep it rather than reallocate resources prematurely.

The move from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024 signals that results likely fell short of aspirations, making this niche product the strongest candidate for problemistic search and withdrawal.
Its own page in both years indicates ongoing commitment and no visible performance shortfall large enough to overcome the firm's slack and patience with recent launches.
The website cites strong rental popularity and a large order, which points to performance above aspiration and supports retaining the product despite its very recent launch.
The dedicated page and quantified early utilisation of 1,000 operating hours in seven months indicate strong initial acceptance, so management would very likely continue the product.
